footer_tagline: Create short links, keep them organized, and review click data from a simple dashboard.
hero_lead: Kurz turns long URLs into short, shareable links and shows you who clicked, from where, and on what device.
bio_title: One link for all your links.
bio_lead: Add your links, pick a theme, share one page. Free, like everything else here.
trust: No paid plans. No credit card. Open source.
fb_analytics_body: See clicks by location, device, and browser.
fb_safety_body: Links are checked with Google Safe Browsing.
fb_password_body: Visitors enter a password before they are redirected.
fb_expire_body: Pick a date and time. The link stops working on its own.
fb_free_body: No plans, no paywalls, no credit card.
fb_oss_body: Code is public on GitHub. Self-host it if you want.
fb_license_comment: # backend, edge function and frontend, MIT licensed

bs_marina_bio: Ceramics and slow mornings. New pieces every month.
bs_nord_bio: Brand and type design from Porto.

fm_lead: Build a form, share the link, and see every booking in one place.
fm_step1_body: Text, email, choice and booking fields. Drag to reorder.
fm_step2_body: Services, days and places per time. A full time stops taking bookings.
fm_step3_body: Every session in one week view. Filter by form and category.
fm_notices_body: Remind, move or cancel a session and the people booked get an email. Emails are best effort; the booking page always shows the truth.
